ownerSuggestion: Discovery mystery considered as an option, not a mandated template.

alternatives.strength: Direct answer with few setup words.
alternatives.weakness: Still resolves into serial explanation inside one visual environment; loses the evidential reason to believe the extraordinary fact.

alternatives.treatment: Discovery-led investigation, then one connected causal reconstruction
alternatives.strength: U235 anomaly and fission fingerprints earn a question before explanation; time/scale transitions provide narrative momentum.
alternatives.weakness: Discovery must stay short and genuine; no invented accusation, scientist disbelief, dramatic quote or fake lab footage.

alternatives.treatment: Water-first paradox: groundwater kept nuclear fission going
alternatives.weakness: Risks making water seem sufficient or fuel; buries the stronger approved deep-time contradiction.

selection: Discovery-led investigation, beginning with extraordinary reality rather than delaying the premise.
compression: Combine place and discovery; avoid separate geographical exposition.
Remove separate radioactive-rock warning after actual fission evidence already establishes the distinction.
Remove isotope half-life comparison: retain larger ancient fissile share, the causal condition needed here.
Combine split/neutron/water/repeated split into one intuitive action, followed by one neutron-economy sentence.
Collapse three cycling stages and repeated reconstruction disclaimers into one explicitly qualified, zone-specific passage.
One payoff resolves heat/non-electricity/natural reaction zones; no recap of every technical stage.
notRemoved: Moderation by hydrogen collisions, distinct from capture.
Joint neutron survival/concentration conditions, not water or fuel alone.
Truthful evidence before ancient physical reconstruction.
runtimePolicy: 127–135 spoken words at established natural narrator pace plus semantic transitions; measured audio determines runtime. No30/45/60/90second target.
